translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhengtong he was abruptly promoted to Guangdong Provincial Administration Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhengtong he was abruptly promoted to Guangdong Provincial Administration Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 荊州知府大庾劉永遭父喪，軍民萬八千餘人乞留，英宗命奪情視事。

translations.literal: Liu Yong of Dayu, prefect of Jingzhou, suffered his father's death; more than eighteen thousand soldiers and civilians petitioned that he be kept in office; the Yingzong Emperor ordered him to set aside mourning and continue in office.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yong of Dayu, prefect of Jingzhou, suffered his father's death; more than eighteen thousand soldiers and civilians petitioned that he be kept in office, and the Yingzong Emperor ordered him to set aside mourning and continue in office.

sentences.zh: 鞏昌知府鄞縣戴浩擅發邊儲三百七十石振饑，被劾請罪，景帝原之。

translations.literal: Dai Hao of Yin county, prefect of Gongchang, on his own authority issued three hundred seventy shi from frontier stores to relieve famine; impeached, he requested punishment, and the Jingdi pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Hao of Yin county, prefect of Gongchang, on his own authority issued three hundred seventy shi from frontier stores to relieve famine; impeached, he requested punishment, and the Jingdi pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 徽州知府孫遇秩滿當遷，民詣闕乞留，英宗令進秩視事。

translations.literal: Sun Yu, prefect of Huizhou, reached the end of his term and was due for transfer; the people went to the capital to petition that he be kept in office; the Yingzong Emperor ordered his rank raised and that he continue in office.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yu, prefect of Huizhou, reached the end of his term and was due for transfer; the people went to the capital to petition that he be kept in office, and the Yingzong Emperor ordered his rank raised and that he continue in office.

sentences.zh: 先後在官十八年，遷至河南布政使。

translations.literal: He served in office eighteen years altogether and was transferred to become provincial administration commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He served in office for eighteen years altogether and was transferred to become provincial administration commissioner of Henan.

sentences.zh: 惟袁旭在甯國為督學御史程富所誣劾，逮死獄中。

translations.literal: Only Yuan Xu, in Ningguo, was falsely impeached by regional inspection censor Cheng Fu, arrested, and died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Only Yuan Xu, in Ningguo, was falsely impeached by regional inspection censor Cheng Fu, arrested, and died in prison.

sentences.zh: 而寧國人惜之，立祠祀焉。

translations.literal: The people of Ningguo mourned him and erected a shrine to worship him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Ningguo mourned him and erected a shrine to worship him.

sentences.zh: 曾泉，泰和人。

translations.literal: Zeng Quan, a native of Taihe.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Quan was a native of Taihe.

sentences.zh: 永樂十八年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the eighteenth year of Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the eighteenth year of Yongle.

sentences.zh: 選庶起士，改御史。

translations.literal: Selected as a Hanlin bachelor, then transferred to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, then transferred to serve as a censor.

sentences.zh: 宣德初，都御史邵甄別屬僚，泉謫汜水典史，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuande, Censor-in-Chief Shao [Gang] appraised his subordinates; Quan was demoted to clerk of record at Sishui and died there.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xuande, Censor-in-Chief Shao Gang appraised his subordinates; Quan was demoted to clerk of record at Sishui and died there.

sentences.zh: 正統四年，河南參政孫原貞上言：「泉操行廉潔，服官勤敏，不以降黜故有偷惰心。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhengtong, Henan Assistant Administration Commissioner Sun Yuanzhen memorialized: "Quan's conduct was honest and clean; in office he was diligent and quick, and because of demotion he did not grow lazy or negligent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhengtong, Henan Assistant Administration Commissioner Sun Yuanzhen memorialized: "Quan's conduct was honest and clean; in office he was diligent and quick, and despite his demotion he did not grow lazy or negligent.

sentences.zh: 躬督民辟荒土，收谷麥，伐材木，備營繕，通商賈，完逋責，官有儲積，民無科擾。

translations.literal: He personally supervised the people in opening wasteland, gathering grain and wheat, felling timber, preparing repairs, opening trade, and clearing arrears; the government had stored reserves and the people suffered no tax harassment.
translations.idiomatic: He personally supervised the people in opening wasteland, gathering grain and wheat, felling timber, preparing repairs, opening trade, and clearing arrears; the government accumulated reserves and the people suffered no tax harassment.

sentences.zh: 造舟楫，置棺槨，膽民器用。

translations.literal: He built boats and oars, provided coffins, and supplied the people's utensils.
translations.idiomatic: He built boats and oars, provided coffins, and supplied the people's daily needs.

sentences.zh: 百姓婚喪不給者，咸資於泉。

translations.literal: Commoners who could not afford weddings or funerals all received support from Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners who could not afford weddings or funerals all received support from Quan.

sentences.zh: 死之日，老幼巷哭。

translations.literal: On the day he died, old and young wept in the lanes.
translations.idiomatic: On the day he died, old and young wept in the lanes.

sentences.zh: 臣行部汜水，泉沒已三年矣，民懷其惠，言輒流涕，雖古循吏，何以加茲。

translations.literal: When I toured Sishui on official business, Quan had already been dead three years; the people cherished his kindness and wept whenever they spoke of him—what ancient virtuous official could surpass this?
translations.idiomatic: When I toured Sishui on official business, Quan had already been dead three years; the people cherished his kindness and wept whenever they spoke of him—what ancient virtuous official could surpass this?

sentences.zh: 若使海內得泉等數十人分治郡邑，可使朝廷恩澤滂流，物鹹得所。

translations.literal: If the realm could obtain several dozen men like Quan to govern prefectures and counties separately, the court's grace could flow abundantly and all things would find their proper place.
translations.idiomatic: If the realm could obtain several dozen men like Quan to govern prefectures and counties, the court's grace could flow abundantly and all things would find their proper place.

sentences.zh: 雖在異代，猶宜下詔褒美。

translations.literal: Even in a different age, it would still be fitting to issue an edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: Even in a different age, it would still be fitting to issue an edict of praise.

sentences.zh: 而獎錄未及，官階未復，使泉終蒙貶謫之名，不獲顯於當世，良可矜恤。

translations.literal: Yet reward and recognition had not reached him, and his official rank had not been restored, so that Quan ultimately bore the name of demotion and could not be distinguished in his own time—this is truly pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: Yet reward and recognition had not reached him, and his official rank had not been restored, so that Quan ultimately bore the stigma of demotion and could not be distinguished in his own time—this is truly pitiable.

sentences.zh: 請追復泉爵，褒既往以風方來。」

translations.literal: I request that Quan's rank be posthumously restored and that past merit be praised to instruct those to come."
translations.idiomatic: I request that Quan's rank be posthumously restored and that past merit be praised to instruct those to come."

sentences.zh: 帝從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 範衷，字恭肅，豐城人。

translations.literal: Fan Zhong, styled Gongsu, a native of Fengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhong, styled Gongsu, was a native of Fengcheng.

sentences.zh: 永樂十九年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the nineteenth year of Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the nineteenth year of Yongle.

sentences.zh: 除壽昌知縣。

translations.literal: Appointed magistrate of Shouchang.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Shouchang.

sentences.zh: 辟荒田二千六百畝，興水利三百四十有六區。

translations.literal: He opened two thousand six hundred mu of wasteland and developed three hundred forty-six irrigation districts.
translations.idiomatic: He opened two thousand six hundred mu of wasteland and developed three hundred forty-six irrigation districts.

sentences.zh: 正統五年三考報最，當遷。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhengtong, after three triennial reviews he was rated highest and was due for transfer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Zhengtong, after three triennial reviews he was rated highest and was due for transfer.

sentences.zh: 邑人頌德乞留，御史以聞，朝廷許之。

translations.literal: The people praised his virtue and petitioned that he be kept in office; the censor reported this, and the court granted it.
translations.idiomatic: The people praised his virtue and petitioned that he be kept in office; the censor reported this, and the court granted it.

sentences.zh: 尋以外艱去，服闋，起知汝州。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he left office on account of his mother's death; when mourning ended he was reappointed magistrate of Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he left office on account of his mother's death; when mourning ended he was reappointed magistrate of Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書王直察舉天下廉吏數人，衷為第一。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Wang Zhi selected several incorrupt officials throughout the realm; Zhong ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Wang Zhi selected several incorrupt officials throughout the realm; Zhong ranked first.

sentences.zh: 性至孝，廬父墓，瓜生連枝，有白兔三，馴擾暮側。

translations.literal: By nature he was extremely filial; he built a hut at his father's tomb; melons grew with joined vines; three white rabbits tamely lingered beside him at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was extremely filial; he built a hut at his father's tomb. Melons grew with joined vines, and three white rabbits tamely lingered beside him at dusk.

sentences.zh: 鄉人莫不高其行。

translations.literal: Everyone in his native place admired his conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone in his native place admired his conduct.

sentences.zh: 周濟，字大亨，洛陽人。

translations.literal: Zhou Ji, styled Daheng, a native of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Ji, styled Daheng, was a native of Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 永樂中，以舉人入太學，曆事都察院。

translations.literal: During Yongle, as a provincial graduate he entered the Imperial Academy and served in the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongle, as a provincial graduate he entered the Imperial Academy and served in the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 都御史劉觀薦為御史，固辭。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Liu Guan recommended him as censor, but he firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Liu Guan recommended him as censor, but he firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 宣德時，授江西都司斷事。

translations.literal: In the Xuande reign he was appointed judicial officer of the Jiangxi Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xuande reign he was appointed judicial officer of the Jiangxi Regional Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 艱歸，補湖廣。

translations.literal: He returned home on account of mourning and was reassigned to Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home on account of mourning and was reassigned to Huguang.

sentences.zh: 正統初，擢御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhengtong he was promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhengtong he was promoted to censor.

sentences.zh: 大同鎮守中官以驕橫聞，敕濟往廉之。

translations.literal: The eunuch garrison commander at Datong was famed for arrogance and overbearing conduct; the Emperor ordered Ji to go investigate him.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch garrison commander at Datong was famed for arrogance and overbearing conduct; the Emperor ordered Ji to go investigate him.

sentences.zh: 濟變服負薪入其宅，盡得不法狀，還報，帝大嘉之。

translations.literal: Ji changed his clothes, shouldered firewood, and entered the man's residence, fully obtaining evidence of illegal conduct; when he reported back, the Emperor greatly praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Ji changed his clothes, shouldered firewood, and entered the man's residence, fully obtaining evidence of illegal conduct. When he reported back, the Emperor greatly praised him.

sentences.zh: 已，巡按四川。

translations.literal: Later he toured and inspected Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Later he toured and inspected Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 威州土官董敏、王允相仇殺，詔濟督官兵進討。

translations.literal: The native chieftains Dong Min and Wang Yun of Weizhou feuded and killed one another; an edict ordered Ji to supervise troops in advancing to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: The native chieftains Dong Min and Wang Yun of Weizhou feuded and killed one another; an edict ordered Ji to supervise troops in advancing to punish them.

sentences.zh: 濟曰：「朝廷綏安遠人，宜先撫而後征。」

translations.literal: Ji said: "The court pacifies distant peoples; one should first soothe and only afterward punish."
translations.idiomatic: Ji said: "The court pacifies distant peoples; one should first soothe and only afterward punish."

sentences.zh: 馳檄諭之，遂解。

translations.literal: He sent a dispatch to instruct them, and the feud was resolved.
translations.idiomatic: He sent a dispatch to instruct them, and the feud was resolved.

sentences.zh: 十一年出為安慶知府，歲比不登，民間鬻子女充衣食，方舟而去者相接。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he went out as prefect of Anqing; year after year the harvest failed, and among the people children were sold for food and clothing; boats laden with those departing followed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he went out as prefect of Anqing; year after year the harvest failed, and among the people children were sold for food and clothing; boats laden with those departing followed one after another.

sentences.zh: 濟借漕糧以振，而禁鬻子女者。

translations.literal: Ji borrowed grain transport supplies to provide relief and forbade the selling of children.
translations.idiomatic: Ji borrowed grain transport supplies to provide relief and forbade the selling of children.

sentences.zh: 且上疏請免租，詔許之，全活甚眾。

translations.literal: He also memorialized requesting rent remission; an edict granted it, and very many lives were saved.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized requesting rent remission; an edict granted it, and very many lives were saved.

sentences.zh: 又為訂婚喪制，禁侈費，愆嫁葬期者有罰，風俗一變。

translations.literal: He also established marriage and mourning regulations, forbade extravagant expense, and punished those who missed wedding or burial deadlines; custom changed entirely.
translations.idiomatic: He also established marriage and mourning regulations, forbade extravagant expense, and punished those who missed wedding or burial deadlines; custom changed entirely.

sentences.zh: 饑民聚掠富家粟，富家以盜劫告。

translations.literal: Starving people gathered to plunder grain from wealthy households; the wealthy reported them as robbers.
translations.idiomatic: Starving people gathered to plunder grain from wealthy households; the wealthy reported them as robbers.

sentences.zh: 濟下令曰：「民饑故如此，然得谷當報太守數，太守當代爾償。」

translations.literal: Ji issued an order saying: "The people are starving and therefore act thus; yet whoever obtains grain must report the amount to the prefect, and the prefect will repay it on your behalf."
translations.idiomatic: Ji issued an order saying: "The people are starving and therefore act thus; yet whoever obtains grain must report the amount to the prefect, and the prefect will repay it on your behalf."

sentences.zh: 掠者遂解散。

translations.literal: The plunderers then dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: The plunderers then dispersed.

sentences.zh: 濟卒官，民皆罷市巷哭雲。

translations.literal: When Ji died in office, the people all closed their shops and wept in the lanes.
translations.idiomatic: When Ji died in office, the people all closed their shops and wept in the lanes.

sentences.zh: 範希正，字以貞，吳縣人。

translations.literal: Fan Xizheng, styled Yizhen, a native of Wu county.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Xizheng, styled Yizhen, was a native of Wu county.

sentences.zh: 宣德三年舉賢良方正，授曹縣知縣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuande he was recommended as worthy and upright and was appointed magistrate of Cao county.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuande he was recommended as worthy and upright and was appointed magistrate of Cao county.

sentences.zh: 有奸吏受賕，希正按其罪，械送京師。

translations.literal: There was a corrupt clerk who accepted bribes; Xizheng investigated his crime and sent him in fetters to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: There was a corrupt clerk who accepted bribes; Xizheng investigated his crime and sent him in fetters to the capital.

sentences.zh: 吏反誣希正他事，坐逮。

translations.literal: The clerk in turn falsely accused Xizheng of other matters, and Xizheng was arrested on that account.
translations.idiomatic: The clerk in turn falsely accused Xizheng of other matters, and Xizheng was arrested on that account.

sentences.zh: 曹民八百餘人詣京白通政司，言希正廉能，橫為奸吏誣枉。

translations.literal: More than eight hundred people of Cao went to the capital and reported to the Office of Transmission that Xizheng was honest and capable and had been falsely wronged by a corrupt clerk.
translations.idiomatic: More than eight hundred people of Cao went to the capital and reported to the Office of Transmission that Xizheng was honest and capable and had been falsely wronged by a corrupt clerk.

sentences.zh: 侍郎許廓以公事過曹，曹父老二百餘人遮道稽顙，泣言朝廷奪我賢令。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Xu Kuo passed through Cao on official business; more than two hundred elders of Cao blocked the road and kowtowed, weeping and saying the court had taken away their worthy magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Xu Kuo passed through Cao on official business; more than two hundred elders of Cao blocked the road and kowtowed, weeping and saying the court had taken away their worthy magistrate.

sentences.zh: 事並聞，帝乃釋希正使還縣。

translations.literal: When both matters were reported, the Emperor released Xizheng and sent him back to the county.
translations.idiomatic: When both matters were reported, the Emperor released Xizheng and sent him back to the county.

sentences.zh: 正統十年，山東饑。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Zhengtong, Shandong suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Zhengtong, Shandong suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 惟曹以希正先積粟，得無患。

translations.literal: Only Cao, because Xizheng had stored grain beforehand, escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: Only Cao, because Xizheng had stored grain beforehand, escaped harm.

sentences.zh: 大理寺丞張驥振山東，聞之。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review Zhang Ji was providing relief in Shandong and heard of this.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review Zhang Ji was providing relief in Shandong and heard of this.

sentences.zh: 因請升曹縣為州，而以希正為知州，從之。

translations.literal: He therefore requested that Cao county be elevated to a prefecture and that Xizheng be made prefect; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore requested that Cao county be elevated to a prefecture and that Xizheng be made prefect; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 時州民負官馬不能償，多逃竄。

translations.literal: At the time the people of the prefecture owed official horses they could not repay and many fled.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the people of the prefecture owed official horses they could not repay and many fled.

sentences.zh: 希正節公費代償九十餘匹，逃者皆復業。

translations.literal: Xizheng economized public funds to repay more than ninety horses on their behalf, and the fugitives all returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Xizheng economized public funds to repay more than ninety horses on their behalf, and the fugitives all returned to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 吉水人誣曹富民殺其兄，連坐甚眾。

translations.literal: A man of Jishui falsely accused a wealthy man of Cao of killing his elder brother, and very many were implicated.
translations.idiomatic: A man of Jishui falsely accused a wealthy man of Cao of killing his elder brother, and very many were implicated.

sentences.zh: 希正密移吉水，按其人姓名皆妄，事得白。

translations.literal: Xizheng secretly sent a dispatch to Jishui and investigated; the names were all false, and the matter was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Xizheng secretly sent a dispatch to Jishui and investigated; the names were all false, and the matter was cleared.

sentences.zh: 治曹二十三年，曆知州，再考乃致仕。

translations.literal: He governed Cao for twenty-three years, served as prefect, and retired only after two triennial reviews.
translations.idiomatic: He governed Cao for twenty-three years, served as prefect, and retired only after two triennial reviews.

sentences.zh: 當是時，潞州知州咸甯燕雲、徐州知州楊秘、全州知州錢塘周健、霸州知州張需、定州知州王約，皆大著聲績。

translations.literal: At this time Yan Yun of Xianning, prefect of Luzhou; Yang Mi, prefect of Xuzhou; Zhou Jian of Qiantang, prefect of Quanzhou; Zhang Xu, prefect of Bazhou; and Wang Yue, prefect of Dingzhou—all greatly distinguished themselves in reputation and achievement.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Yan Yun of Xianning, prefect of Luzhou; Yang Mi, prefect of Xuzhou; Zhou Jian of Qiantang, prefect of Quanzhou; Zhang Xu, prefect of Bazhou; and Wang Yue, prefect of Dingzhou—all greatly distinguished themselves in reputation and achievement.

sentences.zh: 秘、健進秩視事，約賜詔旌異。

translations.literal: Mi and Jian had their ranks raised and continued in office; Yue was granted an edict of special commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Mi and Jian had their ranks raised and continued in office; Yue was granted an edict of special commendation.

sentences.zh: 需忤太監王振戍邊，人尤惜之。

translations.literal: Xu offended the eunuch Wang Zhen and was banished to the frontier; people especially mourned him.
translations.idiomatic: Xu offended the eunuch Wang Zhen and was banished to the frontier; people especially mourned him.

sentences.zh: 而得民最久者，無若希正與寧州知州劉綱。

translations.literal: Yet among those who won the people for the longest time, none matched Xizheng and Liu Gang, prefect of Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yet among those who won the people for the longest time, none matched Xizheng and Liu Gang, prefect of Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 綱，字之紀，禹州人。

translations.literal: Gang, styled Zhiji, a native of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gang, styled Zhiji, was a native of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 建文二年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the second year of Jianwen.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Jianwen.

sentences.zh: 由府谷知縣遷是職。

translations.literal: He was transferred to this post from magistrate of Fugu.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to this post from magistrate of Fugu.

sentences.zh: 蒞州三十四年，仁宗嘗賜酒饌，人以為榮。

translations.literal: He governed the prefecture for thirty-four years; the Renzong once bestowed wine and food on him, which people regarded as an honor.
translations.idiomatic: He governed the prefecture for thirty-four years; the Renzong once bestowed wine and food on him, which people regarded as an honor.

sentences.zh: 正統中，請老去，民送之，涕泣載道。

translations.literal: During Zhengtong he requested to retire on account of age; the people escorted him, weeping all along the road.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhengtong he requested to retire on account of age; the people escorted him, weeping all along the road.

sentences.zh: 及卒，寧民祀之狄仁傑祠中。

translations.literal: When he died, the people of Ning worshipped him in the shrine of Di Renjie.
translations.idiomatic: When he died, the people of Ning worshipped him in the shrine of Di Renjie.

sentences.zh: 其孫，即大學士宇也。

translations.literal: His grandson was none other than the Grand Secretary Yu.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson was none other than the Grand Secretary Yu.

sentences.zh: 段堅，字可大，蘭州人。

translations.literal: Duan Jian, styled Kedà, a native of Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Jian, styled Kedà, was a native of Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 早歲受書，即有志聖賢。

translations.literal: From early youth when he received learning he aspired to the sages.
translations.idiomatic: From early youth when he received learning he aspired to the sages.

sentences.zh: 舉於鄉，入國子監。

translations.literal: Recommended in the provincial examination, he entered the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended in the provincial examination, he entered the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年，上書請悉征還四方監軍，罷天下佛老宮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingtai he memorialized requesting that all garrison troops from the four directions be fully recalled and that Buddhist and Daoist temples throughout the realm be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingtai he memorialized requesting that all garrison troops from the four directions be fully recalled and that Buddhist and Daoist temples throughout the realm be abolished.

sentences.zh: 疏奏，不行。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted but not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted but not implemented.

sentences.zh: 五年成進士，授福山知縣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed magistrate of Fushan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed magistrate of Fushan.

sentences.zh: 刊佈小學，俾士民講誦。

translations.literal: He published the Elementary Learning and had scholars and commoners lecture and recite it.
translations.idiomatic: He published the Elementary Learning and had scholars and commoners lecture and recite it.

sentences.zh: 俗素陋，至是一變，村落皆有糸玄誦聲。

translations.literal: Custom had been crude; by this time it changed entirely, and in every village there was the sound of string and recitation.
translations.idiomatic: Custom had been crude; by this time it changed entirely, and in every village there was the sound of string and recitation.

sentences.zh: 成化初，賜敕旌異，超擢萊州知府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chenghua he was granted an edict of special commendation and was abruptly promoted to prefect of Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chenghua he was granted an edict of special commendation and was abruptly promoted to prefect of Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 期年，化大行。

translations.literal: Within a year, transformation was greatly accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year, transformation was greatly accomplished.

sentences.zh: 以憂去，服除，改知南陽。

translations.literal: He left office on account of mourning; when mourning ended he was reassigned as magistrate of Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: He left office on account of mourning; when mourning ended he was reassigned as magistrate of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 召州縣學官，具告以古人為學之指，使轉相勸誘。

translations.literal: He summoned the educational officers of prefectures and counties and fully explained to them the ancients' purpose in learning, instructing them to encourage one another in turn.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned the educational officers of prefectures and counties and fully explained to them the ancients' purpose in learning, instructing them to encourage one another in turn.

sentences.zh: 創志學書院，聚秀民講說《五經》要義，及濂、洛諸儒遺書。

translations.literal: He founded the Zhixue Academy, gathered talented commoners to lecture on the essential meaning of the Five Classics, and on the surviving writings of the Lian and Luo schools of Confucianism.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the Zhixue Academy, gathered talented commoners to lecture on the essential meaning of the Five Classics, and on the surviving writings of the Lian and Luo schools of Confucianism.

sentences.zh: 建節義祠，祀古今烈女。

translations.literal: He built a shrine to chaste and righteous women, worshipping virtuous women of ancient and modern times.
translations.idiomatic: He built a shrine to chaste and righteous women, worshipping virtuous women of ancient and modern times.

sentences.zh: 訟獄徭賦，務底于平。

translations.literal: In lawsuits, prisons, corvée, and taxation he strove to reach fairness.
translations.idiomatic: In lawsuits, prisons, corvée, and taxation he strove to reach fairness.

sentences.zh: 居數年，大治，引疾去。

translations.literal: After several years the region was greatly well governed; he resigned citing illness.
translations.idiomatic: After several years the region was greatly well governed; he resigned citing illness.

sentences.zh: 士民號泣送者，逾境不絕。

translations.literal: Scholars and commoners who saw him off weeping did not cease even beyond the border.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars and commoners who saw him off weeping did not cease even beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 及聞其卒，立祠，春秋祀之。

translations.literal: When they heard of his death they erected a shrine and worshipped him in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: When they heard of his death they erected a shrine and worshipped him in spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 堅之學，私淑河東薛瑄，務致知而踐其實，不以諛聞取譽，故能以儒術飾吏治。

translations.literal: Jian's learning privately followed Xue Xuan of Hedong; he sought to extend knowledge and put it into practice, and did not seek reputation through flattery, and therefore could adorn official governance with Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: Jian's learning privately followed Xue Xuan of Hedong; he sought to extend knowledge and put it into practice, and did not seek reputation through flattery, and therefore could adorn official governance with Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 子炅，進士，翰林檢討。

translations.literal: His son Jiong was a jinshi and a Hanlin reviser.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jiong was a jinshi and a Hanlin reviser.

sentences.zh: 諂附焦芳，劉瑾敗，落職，隤其家聲焉。

translations.literal: He fawned on Jiao Fang; when Liu Jin fell, he was dismissed from office and brought disgrace upon the family name.
translations.idiomatic: He fawned on Jiao Fang; when Liu Jin fell, he was dismissed from office and brought disgrace upon the family name.

sentences.zh: 丁積，字彥誠，寧都人。

translations.literal: Ding Ji, styled Yancheng, a native of Ningdu.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Ji, styled Yancheng, was a native of Ningdu.

sentences.zh: 成化十四年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the fourteenth year of Chenghua.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourteenth year of Chenghua.

sentences.zh: 授新會知縣，至即師事邑人陳獻章。

translations.literal: Appointed magistrate of Xinhui; upon arrival he took Chen Xianzhang of the county as his teacher.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed magistrate of Xinhui; upon arrival he took Chen Xianzhang of the county as his teacher.

sentences.zh: 為政以風化為本，而主于愛民。

translations.literal: In governing he took moral transformation as his foundation and held to loving the people.
translations.idiomatic: In governing he took moral transformation as his foundation and held to loving the people.

sentences.zh: 中貴梁芳，邑人也，其弟長橫于鄉，責民逋過倍，復訴於積。

translations.literal: The palace eunuch Liang Fang was a native of the county; his younger brother tyrannized the countryside, demanding double payment for overdue taxes from the people, and they again appealed to Ji.
translations.idiomatic: The palace eunuch Liang Fang was a native of the county; his younger brother tyrannized the countryside, demanding double payment for overdue taxes from the people, and they again appealed to Ji.

sentences.zh: 積追券焚之，且收捕系獄，由是權豪屏跡。

translations.literal: Ji pursued him, burned the bonds, and moreover had him arrested and imprisoned; from this the powerful and wealthy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Ji pursued him, burned the bonds, and moreover had him arrested and imprisoned; from this the powerful and wealthy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 申洪武禮制，參以《硃子家禮》，擇耆老誨導百姓。

translations.literal: He applied the Hongwu ritual regulations, supplemented by Zhu Xi's Family Rituals, and selected elders to instruct and guide the common people.
translations.idiomatic: He applied the Hongwu ritual regulations, supplemented by Zhu Xi's Family Rituals, and selected elders to instruct and guide the common people.

sentences.zh: 良家子墮業，聚廡下，使日誦小學書，親為解說，風俗大變。

translations.literal: Sons of good families who had fallen into idleness were gathered under the hall; he had them recite the Elementary Learning daily and personally explained it; custom changed greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Sons of good families who had fallen into idleness were gathered under the hall; he had them recite the Elementary Learning daily and personally explained it; custom changed greatly.

sentences.zh: 民出錢輸官供役，名均平錢。

translations.literal: The people paid money to the government for corvée service, called the Equalization Money.
translations.idiomatic: The people paid money to the government for corvée service, called the Equalization Money.

sentences.zh: 其後吏貪，復令甲首出錢供用，曰當月錢，貧者至鬻子女。

translations.literal: Later clerks grew greedy and again had group heads pay money for expenses, called the Monthly Money; the poor even sold their children.
translations.idiomatic: Later clerks grew greedy and again had group heads pay money for expenses, called the Monthly Money; the poor even sold their children.

sentences.zh: 積一切杜絕。

translations.literal: Ji abolished all of this entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Ji abolished all of this entirely.

sentences.zh: 俗信巫鬼，為痛毀淫祠。

translations.literal: The custom believed in shamans and ghosts; he sternly destroyed licentious shrines.
translations.idiomatic: The custom believed in shamans and ghosts; he sternly destroyed licentious shrines.

sentences.zh: 既而歲大旱，築壇圭峰頂。

translations.literal: Soon afterward there was a great drought; he built an altar on the summit of Guifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward there was a great drought; he built an altar on the summit of Guifeng.

sentences.zh: 昕夕伏壇下者八日，雨大澍。

translations.literal: For eight days he lay prostrate beneath the altar morning and evening; rain fell in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: For eight days he lay prostrate beneath the altar morning and evening; rain fell in abundance.

sentences.zh: 而積遂得疾以卒，士民聚哭於途。

translations.literal: But Ji then fell ill and died; scholars and commoners gathered and wept along the road.
translations.idiomatic: But Ji then fell ill and died; scholars and commoners gathered and wept along the road.

sentences.zh: 有一嫗夜哭極哀，或問之，曰：「來歲當甲首，丁公死，吾無以聊生矣。」

translations.literal: There was an old woman who wept extremely bitterly at night; when asked, she said: "Next year I am to be group head; with Lord Ding dead, I have no way to live."
translations.idiomatic: There was an old woman who wept extremely bitterly at night; when asked, she said: "Next year I am to be group head; with Lord Ding dead, I have no way to live."

sentences.zh: 田鐸，字振之，陽城人。

translations.literal: Tian Duo, styled Zhenzhi, a native of Yangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Duo, styled Zhenzhi, was a native of Yangcheng.

sentences.zh: 成化十四年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the fourteenth year of Chenghua.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourteenth year of Chenghua.

sentences.zh: 授戶部主事，遷員外郎、郎中。

translations.literal: Appointed director in the Ministry of Revenue; transferred to vice director and then director.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed director in the Ministry of Revenue; transferred to vice director and then director.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年奉詔振四川，坐誤遺敕中語，謫蓬州知州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongzhi he was ordered by edict to provide relief in Sichuan; because he mistakenly omitted wording from the edict he was demoted to prefect of Pengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Hongzhi he was ordered by edict to provide relief in Sichuan; because he mistakenly omitted wording from the edict he was demoted to prefect of Pengzhou.

sentences.zh: 州東南有江洲八十二頃，為豪右所據，鐸悉以還民。

translations.literal: Southeast of the prefecture there was a river islet of eighty-two qing occupied by powerful families; Duo returned it all to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast of the prefecture there was a river islet of eighty-two qing occupied by powerful families; Duo returned it all to the people.

sentences.zh: 建大小二十四橋，又鑿三溪山以便行者。

translations.literal: He built twenty-four large and small bridges and also cut through Three Stream Mountain to ease travelers.
translations.idiomatic: He built twenty-four large and small bridges and also cut through Three Stream Mountain to ease travelers.

sentences.zh: 御史行部至蓬，寂無訟者，訝之。

translations.literal: When a censor on tour reached Peng, there was complete silence with no litigants; he was astonished.
translations.idiomatic: When a censor on tour reached Peng, there was complete silence with no litigants; he was astonished.

sentences.zh: 已，乃知州無冤民也，太息而去。

translations.literal: Later he learned that in the prefecture there were no wronged people; he sighed deeply and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Later he learned that in the prefecture there were no wronged people; he sighed deeply and departed.

sentences.zh: 薦於朝，擢廣東僉事。

translations.literal: Recommended to the court, he was promoted to assistant regional inspector of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended to the court, he was promoted to assistant regional inspector of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 遷四川參議，不赴，以老疾告歸。

translations.literal: Transferred to assistant administration commissioner of Sichuan, he did not take up the post and returned home citing old age and illness.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to assistant administration commissioner of Sichuan, he did not take up the post and returned home citing old age and illness.

sentences.zh: 正德時，劉瑾矯詔，言鐸理廣東鹽法，簿牒未明，逮赴廣。

translations.literal: During the Zhengde reign Liu Jin forged an edict saying Duo had managed Guangdong salt law and the records were unclear, and ordered him seized and sent to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengde reign Liu Jin forged an edict saying Duo had managed Guangdong salt law and the records were unclear, and ordered him seized and sent to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 未就道而瑾誅，或勸鐸毋行，鐸不聽，行次九江卒，年八十二矣。

translations.literal: Before he had set out Jin was executed; some urged Duo not to go, but he would not listen; on the road at Jiujiang he died, aged eighty-two.
translations.idiomatic: Before he had set out Jin was executed; some urged Duo not to go, but he would not listen; on the road at Jiujiang he died, aged eighty-two.

sentences.zh: 唐侃，字廷直，丹徒人。

translations.literal: Tang Kan, styled Tingzhi, a native of Dantu.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Kan, styled Tingzhi, was a native of Dantu.

sentences.zh: 正德八年舉於鄉，授永豐知縣。

translations.literal: Recommended in the provincial examination in the eighth year of Zhengde; appointed magistrate of Yongfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended in the provincial examination in the eighth year of Zhengde; appointed magistrate of Yongfeng.

sentences.zh: 之官不攜妻子，獨與一二童僕飯蔬豆羹以居。

translations.literal: Going to his post he did not take wife or children; alone with one or two servants he lived on vegetables and bean broth.
translations.idiomatic: Going to his post he did not take wife or children; alone with one or two servants he lived on vegetables and bean broth.

sentences.zh: 久之，吏民信服。

translations.literal: After a long time clerks and commoners came to trust him.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time clerks and commoners came to trust him.

sentences.zh: 永豐俗刁訟，尚鬼，尤好俳優，侃禁止之。

translations.literal: The custom of Yongfeng was crafty in litigation, honored ghosts, and especially favored actors; Kan forbade all of this.
translations.idiomatic: The custom of Yongfeng was crafty in litigation, honored ghosts, and especially favored actors; Kan forbade all of this.

sentences.zh: 進武定知州。

translations.literal: Promoted to prefect of Wuding.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to prefect of Wuding.

sentences.zh: 會清軍籍，應發遣者至萬二千人。

translations.literal: When the army registers were cleared, those due to be dispatched numbered twelve thousand.
translations.idiomatic: When the army registers were cleared, those due to be dispatched numbered twelve thousand.

sentences.zh: 侃曰：「武定戶口三萬，是空半州也」。

translations.literal: Kan said: "Wuding has thirty thousand households—this would empty half the prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: Kan said: "Wuding has thirty thousand households—this would empty half the prefecture."

sentences.zh: 力爭之。

translations.literal: He argued forcefully against it.
translations.idiomatic: He argued forcefully against it.

sentences.zh: 又有議徙州境徒駭河者，侃復言不宜朘民財填溝壑。

translations.literal: There was also a proposal to relocate the prefecture's border to the Tuohai River; Kan again said it was unsuitable to drain the people's wealth to fill ditches.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a proposal to relocate the prefecture's border to the Tuohai River; Kan again said it was unsuitable to drain the people's wealth to fill ditches.

sentences.zh: 事並得寢。

translations.literal: Both matters were shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Both matters were shelved.

sentences.zh: 章聖皇太后葬承天，諸內奄迫脅所過州縣吏，索金錢，宣言供張不辦者死，州縣吏多逃。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager of Zhangsheng was buried at Chengtian, the inner eunuchs coerced officials of the prefectures and counties they passed through, demanding money and declaring that those who could not provide the funeral arrangements would die; many officials fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager of Zhangsheng was buried at Chengtian, the inner eunuchs coerced officials of the prefectures and counties they passed through, demanding money and declaring that those who could not provide the funeral arrangements would die; many officials fled.

sentences.zh: 侃置空棺旁舍中，奄迫之急，則經至棺所，指而造之曰：「吾辦一死，金錢不可得也。」

translations.literal: Kan placed an empty coffin in a side building; when the eunuchs pressed urgently, he would go to the coffin, point at it, and say: "I can provide one death; money you cannot obtain."
translations.idiomatic: Kan placed an empty coffin in a side building; when the eunuchs pressed urgently, he would go to the coffin, point at it, and say: "I can provide one death; money you cannot obtain."

sentences.zh: 諸奄皆愕眙去。

translations.literal: All the eunuchs stared in astonishment and departed.
translations.idiomatic: All the eunuchs stared in astonishment and departed.

sentences.zh: 稍遷刑部主事，卒。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to director in the Ministry of Punishments; he died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon transferred to director in the Ministry of Punishments; he died.

sentences.zh: 初，侃少時從丁璣學。

translations.literal: At first, when Kan was young he studied under Ding Qi.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Kan was young he studied under Ding Qi.

sentences.zh: 鄰女夜奔之，拒勿納。

translations.literal: A neighbor's daughter came to him at night; he refused and would not accept her.
translations.idiomatic: A neighbor's daughter came to him at night; he refused and would not accept her.

sentences.zh: 其父坐系，侃請代不得，藉草寢地。

translations.literal: His father was imprisoned; Kan requested to take his place but was not permitted, and slept on straw on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: His father was imprisoned; Kan requested to take his place but was not permitted, and slept on straw on the ground.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，父獲宥，乃止。

translations.literal: After more than a year his father was pardoned, and only then did he stop.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year his father was pardoned, and only then did he stop.

sentences.zh: 其操行貞潔，蓋性成也。

translations.literal: His upright and pure conduct was inborn in his nature.
translations.idiomatic: His upright and pure conduct was inborn in his nature.

sentences.zh: 湯紹恩，安嶽人。

translations.literal: Tang Shaoen, a native of Anyue.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shaoen was a native of Anyue.

sentences.zh: 父佐，弘治初進士，仕至參政。

translations.literal: His father Zuo was a jinshi at the beginning of Hongzhi and rose to assistant administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zuo was a jinshi at the beginning of Hongzhi and rose to assistant administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 紹恩以嘉靖五年擢第。

translations.literal: Shaoen passed the examination in the fifth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoen passed the examination in the fifth year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 十四年由戶部郎中遷德安知府，尋移紹興。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was transferred from director in the Ministry of Revenue to prefect of De'an, and soon moved to Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was transferred from director in the Ministry of Revenue to prefect of De'an, and soon moved to Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 為人寬厚長者，性儉素，內服疏布，外以父所遺故袍襲之。

translations.literal: By nature he was generous and elder-like, frugal and plain; inwardly he wore coarse cloth and outwardly wore an old robe left by his father.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was generous and elder-like, frugal and plain; inwardly he wore coarse cloth and outwardly wore an old robe left by his father.

sentences.zh: 始至，新學宮，廣設社學。

translations.literal: When he first arrived he rebuilt the school and broadly established community schools.
translations.idiomatic: When he first arrived he rebuilt the school and broadly established community schools.

sentences.zh: 歲大旱，徒步禱烈日中，雨即降。

translations.literal: In a year of great drought he walked barefoot praying in the blazing sun; rain fell at once.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of great drought he walked barefoot praying in the blazing sun; rain fell at once.

sentences.zh: 緩刑罰，恤貧弱，旌節孝，民情大和。

translations.literal: He eased punishments, cared for the poor and weak, and commended chastity and filial piety; popular sentiment was greatly harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: He eased punishments, cared for the poor and weak, and commended chastity and filial piety; popular sentiment was greatly harmonized.

sentences.zh: 山陰、會稽、蕭山三邑之水，匯三江口入海，潮汐日至，擁沙積如丘陵。

translations.literal: The waters of Shanyin, Kuaiji, and Xiaoshan—the three counties—gather at the Three Rivers mouth and enter the sea; the tide came daily and piled sand like hills.
translations.idiomatic: The waters of Shanyin, Kuaiji, and Xiaoshan—the three counties—gather at the Three Rivers mouth and enter the sea; the tide came daily and piled sand like hills.

sentences.zh: 遇霪潦則水阻，沙不能驟泄，良田盡成巨浸，當事者不得已決塘以瀉之。

translations.literal: When there was prolonged flooding the water was blocked and sand could not be quickly discharged; good fields all became vast inundation; those in charge had no choice but to breach the dikes to drain it.
translations.idiomatic: When there was prolonged flooding the water was blocked and sand could not be quickly discharged; good fields all became vast inundation; those in charge had no choice but to breach the dikes to drain it.

sentences.zh: 塘決則憂旱，歲苦修築。

translations.literal: When the dikes were breached they feared drought, and every year suffered from repair and construction.
translations.idiomatic: When the dikes were breached they feared drought, and every year suffered from repair and construction.

sentences.zh: 紹恩遍行水道，至三江口，見兩山對峙，喜曰：「此下必有石根，余其於此建閘乎？」

translations.literal: Shaoen traveled all the waterways; at the Three Rivers mouth he saw two mountains facing each other and said with delight: "Below here there must be a stone foundation—I shall build a sluice here, shall I not?"
translations.idiomatic: Shaoen traveled all the waterways; at the Three Rivers mouth he saw two mountains facing each other and said with delight: "Below here there must be a stone foundation—I shall build a sluice here, shall I not?"

sentences.zh: 募善水者探之，果有石脈橫互兩山間，遂興工。

translations.literal: He recruited skilled divers to explore and indeed found a stone vein running between the two mountains; work was then begun.
translations.idiomatic: He recruited skilled divers to explore and indeed found a stone vein running between the two mountains; work was then begun.

sentences.zh: 先投以鐵石，繼以籠盛甃屑沉之。

translations.literal: First iron and stone were cast in; then baskets filled with tile fragments were sunk.
translations.idiomatic: First iron and stone were cast in; then baskets filled with tile fragments were sunk.

sentences.zh: 工未半，潮沖蕩不能就，怨讟煩興。

translations.literal: When the work was half done the tide washed and could not hold; complaints and curses arose in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was half done the tide washed and could not hold; complaints and curses arose in abundance.

sentences.zh: 紹恩不為動，禱於海神，潮不至者累日，工遂竣。

translations.literal: Shaoen was unmoved; he prayed to the Sea God, and for many days the tide did not come; the work was then completed.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoen was unmoved; he prayed to the Sea God, and for many days the tide did not come; the work was then completed.

sentences.zh: 修五十餘尋，為閘二十有八，以應列宿。

translations.literal: It was built more than fifty xun long, with twenty-eight sluices corresponding to the lunar lodges.
translations.idiomatic: It was built more than fifty xun long, with twenty-eight sluices corresponding to the lunar lodges.

sentences.zh: 於內為備閘三，曰經漊，曰撞塘，曰平水，以防大閘之潰。

translations.literal: Within were three reserve sluices called Jinglou, Zhuangtang, and Pingshui, to guard against breach of the main sluices.
translations.idiomatic: Within were three reserve sluices called Jinglou, Zhuangtang, and Pingshui, to guard against breach of the main sluices.

sentences.zh: 閘外築石堤四百餘丈扼潮，始不為閘患。

translations.literal: Outside the sluices a stone dike more than four hundred zhang long restrained the tide, so that it no longer threatened the sluices.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the sluices a stone dike more than four hundred zhang long restrained the tide, so that it no longer threatened the sluices.

sentences.zh: 刻水則石間，俾後人相水勢以時啟閉。

translations.literal: Water-level marks were carved between the stones so that later men could gauge the water and open and close in season.
translations.idiomatic: Water-level marks were carved between the stones so that later men could gauge the water and open and close in season.

sentences.zh: 自是，三邑方數百里間無水患矣。

translations.literal: From this time on, within several hundred li among the three counties there was no water disaster.
translations.idiomatic: From this time on, within several hundred li among the three counties there was no water disaster.

sentences.zh: 士民德之，，立廟閘左，歲時奉祀不絕。

translations.literal: Scholars and commoners honored him and erected a temple to the left of the sluice; offerings were made without cease in the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars and commoners honored him and erected a temple to the left of the sluice; offerings were made without cease in the seasons.

sentences.zh: 屢遷山東右布政使，致仕歸，年九十七而卒。

translations.literal: Repeatedly transferred to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Shandong, he retired and returned home and died at ninety-seven.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly transferred to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Shandong, he retired and returned home and died at ninety-seven.

sentences.zh: 初，紹恩之生也，有峨嵋僧過其門，曰：「他日地有稱紹者，將承是兒恩乎？」

translations.literal: When Shaoen was born, a monk from Emei passed his door and said: "In days to come, where there is one called Shao, will he inherit this child's grace?"
translations.idiomatic: When Shaoen was born, a monk from Emei passed his door and said: "In days to come, where there is one called Shao, will he inherit this child's grace?"

sentences.zh: 因名紹恩，字汝承，其後果驗。

translations.literal: He was therefore named Shaoen, styled Rucheng, and afterward it indeed proved true.
translations.idiomatic: He was therefore named Shaoen, styled Rucheng, and afterward it indeed proved true.

sentences.zh: 徐九思，貴溪人。

translations.literal: Xu Jiusi, a native of Guixi.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jiusi was a native of Guixi.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，授句容知縣。

translations.literal: During Jiajing he was appointed magistrate of Jurong.
translations.idiomatic: During Jiajing he was appointed magistrate of Jurong.

sentences.zh: 始視事，恂恂若不能。

translations.literal: When he first took office he seemed deferential, as if incapable.
translations.idiomatic: When he first took office he seemed deferential, as if incapable.

sentences.zh: 俄有吏袖空牒竊印者，九思摘其奸，論如法。

translations.literal: Soon a clerk with an empty document secretly stamped it; Jiusi exposed his fraud and punished him according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Soon a clerk with an empty document secretly stamped it; Jiusi exposed his fraud and punished him according to law.

sentences.zh: 郡吏為叩頭請，不許，於是人人惴恐。

translations.literal: A prefectural clerk kowtowed and begged on his behalf; he did not permit it; from this everyone trembled in fear.
translations.idiomatic: A prefectural clerk kowtowed and begged on his behalf; he did not permit it; from this everyone trembled in fear.

sentences.zh: 為治于單赤務加恩，而禦豪猾特嚴。

translations.literal: In governing he was especially gracious to the solitary and destitute, yet toward the powerful and cunning he was especially strict.
translations.idiomatic: In governing he was especially gracious to the solitary and destitute, yet toward the powerful and cunning he was especially strict.

sentences.zh: 訟者，抶不過十。

translations.literal: For litigants, beating did not exceed ten strokes.
translations.idiomatic: For litigants, beating did not exceed ten strokes.

sentences.zh: 諸所催科，預為之期，逾期，令裏老逮之而已，隸莫敢至鄉落。

translations.literal: For all tax collection he set deadlines in advance; when overdue, he had village elders arrest them—that was all—and runners dared not enter the villages.
translations.idiomatic: For all tax collection he set deadlines in advance; when overdue, he had village elders arrest them—that was all—and runners dared not enter the villages.

sentences.zh: 縣東西通衢七十里，塵土積三尺，雨雪，泥沒股。

translations.literal: The main road east and west through the county was seventy li; dust piled three chi deep; in rain and snow mud reached the thighs.
translations.idiomatic: The main road east and west through the county was seventy li; dust piled three chi deep; in rain and snow mud reached the thighs.

sentences.zh: 九思節公費，甃以石，行旅便之。

translations.literal: Jiusi economized public funds and paved it with stone; travelers found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Jiusi economized public funds and paved it with stone; travelers found it convenient.

sentences.zh: 朝廷數遣中貴醮神三茅山，縣民苦供應。

translations.literal: The court repeatedly sent palace eunuchs to perform rites at Mount Sanmao; the county people suffered from the supplies demanded.
translations.idiomatic: The court repeatedly sent palace eunuchs to perform rites at Mount Sanmao; the county people suffered from the supplies demanded.

sentences.zh: 九思搜故牒，有鹽引金久貯於府者，請以給嘗，民無所擾。

translations.literal: Jiusi searched old records and found salt certificates and gold long stored in the prefecture; he requested that these be used for the expenses so the people were undisturbed.
translations.idiomatic: Jiusi searched old records and found salt certificates and gold long stored in the prefecture; he requested that these be used for the expenses so the people were undisturbed.

sentences.zh: 歲侵，穀湧貴。

translations.literal: In a year of crop failure grain prices soared.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of crop failure grain prices soared.

sentences.zh: 巡撫發倉谷數百石，使平價糶而償直於官。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator issued several hundred shi of grain from the granary and had it sold at fair price, with payment to the government.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator issued several hundred shi of grain from the granary and had it sold at fair price, with payment to the government.

sentences.zh: 九思曰：「彼糴者，皆豪也。

translations.literal: Jiusi said: "Those who buy are all wealthy.
translations.idiomatic: Jiusi said: "Those who buy are all wealthy.

sentences.zh: 貧民雖平價不能糴。」

translations.literal: Poor people even at fair price cannot buy."
translations.idiomatic: Poor people even at fair price cannot buy."

sentences.zh: 乃以時價糶其半，還直於官，而以余穀煮粥食餓者。

translations.literal: He therefore sold half at market price and returned payment to the government, and with the remaining grain cooked porridge to feed the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore sold half at market price and returned payment to the government, and with the remaining grain cooked porridge to feed the hungry.

sentences.zh: 穀多，則使稱力分負以去，其山谷遠者，則就旁富人穀，而官為償之，全活甚眾。

translations.literal: When grain was abundant he had people carry away shares according to strength; for those in distant mountain valleys he had them take grain from nearby wealthy households and the government repaid on their behalf; very many lives were saved.
translations.idiomatic: When grain was abundant he had people carry away shares according to strength; for those in distant mountain valleys he had them take grain from nearby wealthy households and the government repaid on their behalf; very many lives were saved.

sentences.zh: 嘗曰：「即天子布大惠，安能人人蠲租賜復，第在吾曹酌緩急而已。」

translations.literal: He once said: "Even if the Son of Heaven bestows great grace, how can he exempt every man's rent and grant relief to all? It lies only in us to weigh urgency and ease."
translations.idiomatic: He once said: "Even if the Son of Heaven bestows great grace, how can he exempt every man's rent and grant relief to all? It lies only in us to weigh urgency and ease."

sentences.zh: 久之，與應天府尹不合，為巡撫所劾，吏部尚書熊浹知其賢，特留之。

translations.literal: After a long time he fell out with the prefect of Yingtian and was impeached by the grand coordinator; Minister of Personnel Xiong Xian knew his worth and specially kept him in office.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he fell out with the prefect of Yingtian and was impeached by the grand coordinator; Minister of Personnel Xiong Xian knew his worth and specially kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 積九載，遷工部主事，曆郎中，治張秋河道。

translations.literal: After nine years he was transferred to director in the Ministry of Works, served as bureau director, and managed the Zhangqiu river works.
translations.idiomatic: After nine years he was transferred to director in the Ministry of Works, served as bureau director, and managed the Zhangqiu river works.

sentences.zh: 漕河與鹽河近而不相接，漕水溢則氾濫為田患。

translations.literal: The grain transport canal and the salt canal were close but not connected; when transport water overflowed it flooded and became a disaster for the fields.
translations.idiomatic: The grain transport canal and the salt canal were close but not connected; when transport water overflowed it flooded and became a disaster for the fields.

sentences.zh: 九思議築減水橋于沙灣，俾二水相通，漕水溢，則有所泄以入海，而不侵田，少則有所限而不至於涸。

translations.literal: Jiusi proposed building a flood-release bridge at Shawan so the two waters could connect; when transport water overflowed there would be an outlet to the sea without harming the fields, and when low there would be a limit so it would not dry up.
translations.idiomatic: Jiusi proposed building a flood-release bridge at Shawan so the two waters could connect; when transport water overflowed there would be an outlet to the sea without harming the fields, and when low there would be a limit so it would not dry up.

sentences.zh: 工成，遂為永利。

translations.literal: When the work was completed it became a lasting benefit.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was completed it became a lasting benefit.

sentences.zh: 時工部尚書趙文華視師東南，道河上。

translations.literal: At the time Minister of Works Zhao Wenhua was inspecting troops in the southeast and passed along the river.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Minister of Works Zhao Wenhua was inspecting troops in the southeast and passed along the river.

sentences.zh: 九思不出迎，遣一吏齎牒往謁，文華嫚罵而去。

translations.literal: Jiusi did not go out to welcome him but sent one clerk with a dispatch to pay his respects; Wenhua reviled him and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Jiusi did not go out to welcome him but sent one clerk with a dispatch to pay his respects; Wenhua reviled him and departed.

sentences.zh: 會遷高州知府。

translations.literal: He happened to be transferred to prefect of Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He happened to be transferred to prefect of Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 文華歸，修舊怨，與吏部尚書吳鵬合謀構之，遂坐九思老，致仕。

translations.literal: When Wenhua returned he nursed his old grievance and conspired with Minister of Personnel Wu Peng to frame him; Jiusi was therefore judged old and retired.
translations.idiomatic: When Wenhua returned he nursed his old grievance and conspired with Minister of Personnel Wu Peng to frame him; Jiusi was therefore judged old and retired.

sentences.zh: 句容民為建祠茅山。

translations.literal: The people of Jurong built him a shrine on Mount Mao.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jurong built him a shrine on Mount Mao.

sentences.zh: 九思家居二十二年，年八十五，抱疾，抗手曰「茅山迎我」，遂卒。

translations.literal: At home for twenty-two years, aged eighty-five, he fell ill; raising his hand he said "Mount Mao welcomes me," and died.
translations.idiomatic: At home for twenty-two years, aged eighty-five, he fell ill; raising his hand he said "Mount Mao welcomes me," and died.

sentences.zh: 子貞明，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Zhenming has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhenming has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 龐嵩，字振卿，南海人。

translations.literal: Pang Song, styled Zhenqing, a native of Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Song, styled Zhenqing, was a native of Nanhai.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十三年舉於鄉。

translations.literal: Recommended in the provincial examination in the thirteenth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended in the provincial examination in the thirteenth year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 講業羅浮山，從遊者雲集。

translations.literal: He lectured on Mount Luofu; those who followed to study gathered like clouds.
translations.idiomatic: He lectured on Mount Luofu; those who followed to study gathered like clouds.

sentences.zh: 二十三年曆應天通判，進治中，先後凡八年。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he served as vice prefect of Yingtian and was promoted to administrative vice prefect; altogether eight years.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he served as vice prefect of Yingtian and was promoted to administrative vice prefect; altogether eight years.

sentences.zh: 府缺尹，屢攝其事。

translations.literal: When the prefecture lacked a prefect he repeatedly acted in that capacity.
translations.idiomatic: When the prefecture lacked a prefect he repeatedly acted in that capacity.

sentences.zh: 始至，值歲饑，上官命督振。

translations.literal: When he first arrived there was famine; his superiors ordered him to supervise relief.
translations.idiomatic: When he first arrived there was famine; his superiors ordered him to supervise relief.

sentences.zh: 公粟竭，貸之巨室富家，全活者六萬七千餘人。

translations.literal: Public grain was exhausted; he borrowed from great houses and wealthy families, saving more than sixty-seven thousand lives.
translations.idiomatic: Public grain was exhausted; he borrowed from great houses and wealthy families, saving more than sixty-seven thousand lives.

sentences.zh: 乃蠲積逋，緩徵徭，勤勞徠，復業者又十萬餘人。

translations.literal: He then remitted accumulated arrears, eased tax levies, and diligently encouraged return; more than one hundred thousand people resumed their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: He then remitted accumulated arrears, eased tax levies, and diligently encouraged return; more than one hundred thousand people resumed their occupations.

sentences.zh: 留都民苦役重，力為調劑，凡優免戶及寄居客戶、詭稱官戶、寄莊戶、女戶、神帛堂匠戶，俾悉出以供役，民困大蘇。

translations.literal: The people of the capital suffered from heavy corvée; he worked hard to adjust it; all exempt households, resident guest households, those falsely claiming official households, attached estate households, female households, and divine-silk hall artisan households were all made to perform corvée; the people's hardship was greatly relieved.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the capital suffered from heavy corvée; he worked hard to adjust it; all exempt households, resident guest households, those falsely claiming official households, attached estate households, female households, and divine-silk hall artisan households were all made to perform corvée; the people's hardship was greatly relieved.

sentences.zh: 江甯縣葛仙、永豐二鄉，頻遭水患，居民止存七戶。

translations.literal: The two townships of Gexian and Yongfeng in Jiangning county frequently suffered water disasters; only seven households of residents remained.
translations.idiomatic: The two townships of Gexian and Yongfeng in Jiangning county frequently suffered water disasters; only seven households of residents remained.

sentences.zh: 嵩為治堤築防，得田三千六百畝，立惠民莊四，召貧民佃之，流移盡復。

translations.literal: Song built dikes and defenses, recovered three thousand six hundred mu of fields, established four Benefiting-the-People estates, summoned poor people to tenant them, and all the displaced returned.
translations.idiomatic: Song built dikes and defenses, recovered three thousand six hundred mu of fields, established four Benefiting-the-People estates, summoned poor people to tenant them, and all the displaced returned.

sentences.zh: 屢剖冤獄，戚畹王湧、舉人趙君寵占良人妻，殺人，嵩置之法。

translations.literal: Repeatedly he cleared wrongful cases; the imperial relative Wang Yong and provincial graduate Zhao Junchong seized another man's wife and killed a man; Song punished them according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly he cleared wrongful cases; the imperial relative Wang Yong and provincial graduate Zhao Junchong seized another man's wife and killed a man; Song punished them according to law.

sentences.zh: 早游王守仁門，淹通《五經》。

translations.literal: Early on he studied under Wang Shouren and was thoroughly versed in the Five Classics.
translations.idiomatic: Early on he studied under Wang Shouren and was thoroughly versed in the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 集諸生新泉書院，相與講習。

translations.literal: He gathered students at the Xinquan Academy to lecture and study together.
translations.idiomatic: He gathered students at the Xinquan Academy to lecture and study together.

sentences.zh: 歲時單騎行縣，以壺漿自隨。

translations.literal: At the seasons he rode alone through the counties, carrying wine and food himself.
translations.idiomatic: At the seasons he rode alone through the counties, carrying wine and food himself.

sentences.zh: 京府佐貳鮮有舉其職者，至嵩以善政特聞。

translations.literal: Assistant officials of the capital prefecture rarely fulfilled their duties; Song was specially noted for good governance.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant officials of the capital prefecture rarely fulfilled their duties; Song was specially noted for good governance.

sentences.zh: 府官在六年京察例，而復與外察。

translations.literal: Prefectural officials were subject to the six-year capital evaluation and also to external evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural officials were subject to the six-year capital evaluation and also to external evaluation.

sentences.zh: 嵩謂非體，疏請止之，遂為永制。

translations.literal: Song said this was improper and memorialized requesting that it be stopped; it then became a permanent regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Song said this was improper and memorialized requesting that it be stopped; it then became a permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 遷南京刑部員外郎，進郎中。

translations.literal: Transferred to vice director in the Nanjing Ministry of Punishments; promoted to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to vice director in the Nanjing Ministry of Punishments; promoted to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 撰《原刑》、《司刑》、《祥刑》、《明刑》四篇，曰《刑曹志》，時議稱之。

translations.literal: He wrote four essays, "On the Origin of Punishment," "On Administering Punishment," "On Auspicious Punishment," and "On Clarifying Punishment," called Records of the Punishments Bureau; contemporaries praised them.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote four essays, "On the Origin of Punishment," "On Administering Punishment," "On Auspicious Punishment," and "On Clarifying Punishment," called Records of the Punishments Bureau; contemporaries praised them.

sentences.zh: 遷雲南曲靖知府，亦有政聲。

translations.literal: Transferred to prefect of Qujing in Yunnan; he also had a reputation for good governance.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to prefect of Qujing in Yunnan; he also had a reputation for good governance.

sentences.zh: 中察典，以老罷，而年僅五十。

translations.literal: At the mid-term evaluation he was dismissed for age, yet he was only fifty.
translations.idiomatic: At the mid-term evaluation he was dismissed for age, yet he was only fifty.

sentences.zh: 復從湛若水遊，久之卒。

translations.literal: He again followed Zhan Ruoshui in study and died after a long time.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Zhan Ruoshui in study and died after a long time.

sentences.zh: 應天、曲靖皆祠之名宦，葛仙鄉專祠祀之。

translations.literal: Both Yingtian and Qujing enshrined him among noted officials; Gexian township had a dedicated shrine to worship him.
translations.idiomatic: Both Yingtian and Qujing enshrined him among noted officials; Gexian township had a dedicated shrine to worship him.

sentences.zh: 張淳，字希古，桐城人。

translations.literal: Zhang Chun, styled Xigu, a native of Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chun, styled Xigu, was a native of Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年進士，授永康知縣。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the second year of Longqing; appointed magistrate of Yongkang.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of the second year of Longqing; appointed magistrate of Yongkang.

sentences.zh: 吏民素多奸黠，連告罷七令。

translations.literal: Clerks and commoners had long been crafty and cunning; successive petitions had caused seven magistrates to be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks and commoners had long been crafty and cunning; successive petitions had caused seven magistrates to be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 淳至，日夜閱案牘。

translations.literal: When Chun arrived he reviewed case records day and night.
translations.idiomatic: When Chun arrived he reviewed case records day and night.

sentences.zh: 訟者數千人，剖決如流，吏民大駭，服，訟浸減。

translations.literal: Litigants numbered several thousand; he decided cases like flowing water; clerks and commoners were greatly astonished and submitted; lawsuits gradually diminished.
translations.idiomatic: Litigants numbered several thousand; he decided cases like flowing water; clerks and commoners were greatly astonished and submitted; lawsuits gradually diminished.

sentences.zh: 凡赴控者，淳即示審期，兩造如期至，片晷分析無留滯。

translations.literal: For all who came to lodge complaints Chun set a trial date; both parties arrived on schedule and within a brief interval he analyzed the case without delay.
translations.idiomatic: For all who came to lodge complaints Chun set a trial date; both parties arrived on schedule and within a brief interval he analyzed the case without delay.

sentences.zh: 鄉民裹飯一包即可畢訟，因呼為「張一包」，謂其敏斷如包拯也。

translations.literal: Country people needed only a bundle of rice to finish a lawsuit, and therefore called him "Zhang One-Bundle," saying his swift judgment was like Bao Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Country people needed only a bundle of rice to finish a lawsuit, and therefore called him "Zhang One-Bundle," saying his swift judgment was like Bao Zheng.

sentences.zh: 巨盜盧十八剽庫金，十餘年不獲，御史以屬淳。

translations.literal: The great bandit Lu Shiba robbed treasury gold; for more than ten years he was not captured; the censor entrusted the matter to Chun.
translations.idiomatic: The great bandit Lu Shiba robbed treasury gold; for more than ten years he was not captured; the censor entrusted the matter to Chun.

sentences.zh: 淳刻期三月必得盜，而請御史月下數十檄。

translations.literal: Chun set a deadline of three months to capture the thief and requested that the censor send down dozens of dispatches each month.
translations.idiomatic: Chun set a deadline of three months to capture the thief and requested that the censor send down dozens of dispatches each month.

sentences.zh: 及檄累下，淳陽笑曰：「盜遁久矣，安從捕。」

translations.literal: When the dispatches piled up Chun openly laughed and said: "The thief fled long ago—how can he be captured?"
translations.idiomatic: When the dispatches piled up Chun openly laughed and said: "The thief fled long ago—how can he be captured?"

sentences.zh: 寢不行。

translations.literal: He let the matter lie and did not act.
translations.idiomatic: He let the matter lie and did not act.

sentences.zh: 吏某婦與十八通，吏頗為耳目，聞淳言以告十八，十八意自安。

translations.literal: A certain clerk's wife had relations with Shiba; the clerk served somewhat as his eyes and ears; hearing Chun's words he told Shiba, and Shiba's mind grew easy.
translations.idiomatic: A certain clerk's wife had relations with Shiba; the clerk served somewhat as his eyes and ears; hearing Chun's words he told Shiba, and Shiba's mind grew easy.

sentences.zh: 淳乃令他役詐告吏負金，系吏獄。

translations.literal: Chun then had another runner falsely accuse the clerk of owing money and imprisoned the clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Chun then had another runner falsely accuse the clerk of owing money and imprisoned the clerk.

sentences.zh: 密召吏責以通盜死罪，復教之請以婦代系，而己出營貲以償。

translations.literal: Secretly summoning the clerk he charged him with the capital crime of communicating with the thief, then instructed him to request that his wife be imprisoned in his place while he went out to raise funds to repay.
translations.idiomatic: Secretly summoning the clerk he charged him with the capital crime of communicating with the thief, then instructed him to request that his wife be imprisoned in his place while he went out to raise funds to repay.

sentences.zh: 十八聞，亟往視婦，因醉而擒之。

translations.literal: When Shiba heard this he hurried to see the wife and, while drunk, was seized.
translations.idiomatic: When Shiba heard this he hurried to see the wife and, while drunk, was seized.

sentences.zh: 及報御史，僅兩月耳。

translations.literal: When he reported to the censor it had been only two months.
translations.idiomatic: When he reported to the censor it had been only two months.

sentences.zh: 民有睚眥嫌，輒以人命訟。

translations.literal: When people had petty grudges they would bring capital cases.
translations.idiomatic: When people had petty grudges they would bring capital cases.

sentences.zh: 淳驗無實即坐之，自是無誣訟者。

translations.literal: Chun investigated and if there was no substance he punished the accuser; from this there were no false lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: Chun investigated and if there was no substance he punished the accuser; from this there were no false lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 永人貧，生女多不舉。

translations.literal: The people of Yong were poor and often did not raise daughters.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Yong were poor and often did not raise daughters.

sentences.zh: 淳勸誡備至，貧無力者捐俸量給，全活無數。

translations.literal: Chun admonished them exhaustively; for those too poor he donated salary as appropriate; countless lives were saved.
translations.idiomatic: Chun admonished them exhaustively; for those too poor he donated salary as appropriate; countless lives were saved.

sentences.zh: 歲旱，劫掠公行，下令劫奪者死。

translations.literal: In a year of drought robbery was openly committed; he ordered that looters be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of drought robbery was openly committed; he ordered that looters be put to death.

sentences.zh: 有奪五斗米者，淳佯取死囚杖殺之，而榜其罪曰「是劫米者」，眾旨懾服。

translations.literal: There was one who seized five dou of rice; Chun feigned taking a condemned prisoner and had him beaten to death, posting his crime as "This man looted rice"; the crowd was awed and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: There was one who seized five dou of rice; Chun feigned taking a condemned prisoner and had him beaten to death, posting his crime as "This man looted rice"; the crowd was awed and submitted.

sentences.zh: 久之，以治行第一赴召去永，甫就車，顧其下曰：「某盜已來，去此數里，可為我縛來。」

translations.literal: After a long time, ranked first in governance, he was summoned and left Yong; just as he entered the carriage he looked back at his attendants and said: "A certain thief has come; he is a few li from here—bind him for me."
translations.idiomatic: After a long time, ranked first in governance, he was summoned and left Yong; just as he entered the carriage he looked back at his attendants and said: "A certain thief has come; he is a few li from here—bind him for me."

sentences.zh: 如言跡之，盜正濯足於河，系至，盜服辜。

translations.literal: As they said, they tracked him; the thief was washing his feet in the river; bound and brought in, the thief confessed guilt.
translations.idiomatic: As they said, they tracked him; the thief was washing his feet in the river; bound and brought in, the thief confessed guilt.

sentences.zh: 永人駭其事，謂有神告。

translations.literal: The people of Yong were astonished at the affair and said a god had informed him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Yong were astonished at the affair and said a god had informed him.

sentences.zh: 淳曰：「此盜捕之急則遁，今聞吾去乃歸耳。

translations.literal: Chun said: "This thief, pressed hard in capture, would flee; now hearing I am leaving he has returned.
translations.idiomatic: Chun said: "This thief, pressed hard in capture, would flee; now hearing I am leaving he has returned.

sentences.zh: 以理卜，何神之有。」

translations.literal: By reasoning one can predict it—what god is there?"
translations.idiomatic: By reasoning one can predict it—what god is there?"

sentences.zh: 擢禮部主事，曆郎中，謝病去。

translations.literal: Promoted to director in the Ministry of Rites; served as bureau director; resigned citing illness.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to director in the Ministry of Rites; served as bureau director; resigned citing illness.

sentences.zh: 起建甯知府，進浙江副使。

translations.literal: Recalled as prefect of Jianning; promoted to vice commissioner of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled as prefect of Jianning; promoted to vice commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 時浙江有召募兵，撫按議散之，兵皆洶洶。

translations.literal: At the time Zhejiang had recruited troops; the grand coordinator and regional inspector proposed disbanding them; the troops were all turbulent.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhejiang had recruited troops; the grand coordinator and regional inspector proposed disbanding them; the troops were all turbulent.

sentences.zh: 淳曰：「是憍悍者，留則有用，汰則叵測。

translations.literal: Chun said: "These are proud and fierce men; kept they are useful, dismissed they are unpredictable.
translations.idiomatic: Chun said: "These are proud and fierce men; kept they are useful, dismissed they are unpredictable.

sentences.zh: 不若汰其老弱，而留其壯勇，則留者不思亂，汰者不能亂矣。」

translations.literal: Better to dismiss the old and weak and keep the strong and brave; then those kept will not think of rebellion and those dismissed cannot rebel."
translations.idiomatic: Better to dismiss the old and weak and keep the strong and brave; then those kept will not think of rebellion and those dismissed cannot rebel."

sentences.zh: 從之，事遂定。

translations.literal: The proposal was followed and the matter was settled.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was followed and the matter was settled.

sentences.zh: 官終陝西布政。

translations.literal: He ended his career as provincial administration commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He ended his career as provincial administration commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 陳幼學，字志行，無錫人。

translations.literal: Chen Youxue, styled Zhixing, a native of Wuxi.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Youxue, styled Zhixing, was a native of Wuxi.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十七年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the seventeenth year of Wanli.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the seventeenth year of Wanli.

sentences.zh: 授確山知縣。

translations.literal: Appointed magistrate of Queshan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Queshan.

sentences.zh: 政務惠民，積粟萬二千石以備荒，墾萊田八百餘頃，給貧民牛五百餘頭，核黃河退地百三十餘頃以賦民。
