translations.literal: In governing he sought to benefit the people; he stored twelve thousand shi of grain against famine, reclaimed more than eight hundred qing of wasteland, gave five hundred head of cattle to poor people, and verified more than one hundred thirty qing of Yellow River retreat land to assign to the people.
translations.idiomatic: In governing he sought to benefit the people; he stored twelve thousand shi of grain against famine, reclaimed more than eight hundred qing of wasteland, gave five hundred head of cattle to poor people, and verified more than one hundred thirty qing of Yellow River retreat land to assign to the people.

sentences.zh: 裏婦不能紡者，授紡車八百餘輛。

translations.literal: For village women who could not spin he provided more than eight hundred spinning wheels.
translations.idiomatic: For village women who could not spin he provided more than eight hundred spinning wheels.

sentences.zh: 置屋千二百餘間，分處貧民。

translations.literal: He built more than twelve hundred rooms to house poor people separately.
translations.idiomatic: He built more than twelve hundred rooms to house poor people separately.

sentences.zh: 建公廨八十間，以居六曹吏，俾食宿其中。

translations.literal: He built eighty public offices to house the six department clerks and had them eat and sleep there.
translations.idiomatic: He built eighty public offices to house the six department clerks and had them eat and sleep there.

sentences.zh: 節公費六百餘兩，代正賦之無征者。

translations.literal: He economized more than six hundred taels of public funds to cover unpaid regular taxes.
translations.idiomatic: He economized more than six hundred taels of public funds to cover unpaid regular taxes.

sentences.zh: 栽桑榆諸樹三萬八千餘株，開河渠百九十八道。

translations.literal: He planted more than thirty-eight thousand mulberry, elm, and other trees and opened one hundred ninety-eight canals.
translations.idiomatic: He planted more than thirty-eight thousand mulberry, elm, and other trees and opened one hundred ninety-eight canals.

sentences.zh: 布政使劉渾成弟燦成助妾殺妻，治如律。

translations.literal: Provincial Administration Commissioner Liu Huncheng's younger brother Can Cheng helped a concubine kill his wife; Youxue punished them according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Administration Commissioner Liu Huncheng's younger brother Can Cheng helped a concubine kill his wife; Youxue punished them according to law.

sentences.zh: 行太僕卿陳耀文家人犯法，立捕治之。

translations.literal: Acting Chief of the Court of the Imperial Stud Chen Yaowen's household committed an offense; he immediately arrested and punished them.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Chief of the Court of the Imperial Stud Chen Yaowen's household committed an offense; he immediately arrested and punished them.

sentences.zh: 汝甯知府邱度慮幼學得禍，言於撫按，調繁中牟。

translations.literal: Prefect of Runing Qiu Du feared Youxue would meet disaster and spoke to the grand coordinator and regional inspector; he was transferred to the demanding post of Zhongmou.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect of Runing Qiu Du feared Youxue would meet disaster and spoke to the grand coordinator and regional inspector; he was transferred to the demanding post of Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 秋成時，飛蝗蔽天。

translations.literal: At harvest time locusts blotted out the sky.
translations.idiomatic: At harvest time locusts blotted out the sky.

sentences.zh: 幼學捕蝗，得千三百余石，乃不為災。

translations.literal: Youxue captured locusts and obtained more than thirteen hundred shi; disaster was thereby averted.
translations.idiomatic: Youxue captured locusts and obtained more than thirteen hundred shi; disaster was thereby averted.

sentences.zh: 縣故土城，卑且圮。

translations.literal: The county's old earthen walls were low and crumbling.
translations.idiomatic: The county's old earthen walls were low and crumbling.

sentences.zh: 給饑民粟，俾修築，工成，民不知役。

translations.literal: He gave grain to hungry people and had them repair and build; when the work was done the people did not know they had performed corvée.
translations.idiomatic: He gave grain to hungry people and had them repair and build; when the work was done the people did not know they had performed corvée.

sentences.zh: 縣南荒地多茂草，根深難墾。

translations.literal: South of the county wasteland had thick grass whose roots were deep and hard to plow.
translations.idiomatic: South of the county wasteland had thick grass whose roots were deep and hard to plow.

sentences.zh: 令民投牒者，必入草十斤。

translations.literal: He ordered that anyone submitting a petition must also bring ten jin of grass.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered that anyone submitting a petition must also bring ten jin of grass.

sentences.zh: 未幾，草盡，得沃田數百頃，悉以畀民。

translations.literal: Before long the grass was exhausted; he obtained several hundred qing of fertile fields and assigned them all to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the grass was exhausted; he obtained several hundred qing of fertile fields and assigned them all to the people.

sentences.zh: 有大澤，積水，占膏腴地二十餘里。

translations.literal: There was a great marsh with accumulated water occupying more than twenty li of rich land.
translations.idiomatic: There was a great marsh with accumulated water occupying more than twenty li of rich land.

sentences.zh: 幼學疏為河者五十七，為渠者百三十九，俱引入小清河，民大獲利。

translations.literal: Youxue dredged fifty-seven rivers and one hundred thirty-nine canals, all leading into the Xiaoqing River; the people greatly profited.
translations.idiomatic: Youxue dredged fifty-seven rivers and one hundred thirty-nine canals, all leading into the Xiaoqing River; the people greatly profited.

sentences.zh: 大莊諸裏多水，為築堤十三道障之。

translations.literal: The various hamlets of Dazhuang had much water; he built thirteen dikes to block it.
translations.idiomatic: The various hamlets of Dazhuang had much water; he built thirteen dikes to block it.

sentences.zh: 給貧民牛種，貧婦紡具，倍於確山。

translations.literal: He gave cattle and seed to poor people and spinning equipment to poor women—twice as much as at Queshan.
translations.idiomatic: He gave cattle and seed to poor people and spinning equipment to poor women—twice as much as at Queshan.

sentences.zh: 越五年，政績茂著。

translations.literal: After five years his achievements were abundant and distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: After five years his achievements were abundant and distinguished.

sentences.zh: 以不通權貴，當考察拾遺，掌道御史擬斥之，其子爭曰：「兒自中州來，咸言中牟治行無雙。

translations.literal: Because he did not cultivate the powerful, at the evaluation for selecting omissions the touring censor proposed to dismiss him; his son protested: "Your son has come from the central provinces; all say Zhongmou's governance is unmatched.
translations.idiomatic: Because he did not cultivate the powerful, at the evaluation for selecting omissions the touring censor proposed to dismiss him; his son protested: "Your son has come from the central provinces; all say Zhongmou's governance is unmatched.

sentences.zh: 今予殿，何也？」

translations.literal: Now you rank me last—why?"
translations.idiomatic: Now you rank me last—why?"

sentences.zh: 乃已。

translations.literal: The matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was then dropped.

sentences.zh: 稍遷刑部主事。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to director in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Soon transferred to director in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 中官采禦園果者，怒殺園夫母，棄其屍河中。

translations.literal: A palace eunuch gathering imperial garden fruit angrily killed a gardener's mother and threw her corpse into the river.
translations.idiomatic: A palace eunuch gathering imperial garden fruit angrily killed a gardener's mother and threw her corpse into the river.

sentences.zh: 幼學具奏，逮置之法。

translations.literal: Youxue fully memorialized; the man was arrested and punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Youxue fully memorialized; the man was arrested and punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 嘉興人袁黃妄批削《四書》、《書經集注》，名曰《刪正》，刊行于時。

translations.literal: Yuan Huang of Jiaxing rashly annotated and abridged the Four Books and the Collected Commentaries on the Book of Documents, calling the work Corrections, and published it at the time.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Huang of Jiaxing had rashly edited and cut the Four Books and Zhu Xi's commentary on the Book of Documents into a work he called Corrections, which was then published.

sentences.zh: 幼學駁正其書，抗疏論列。

translations.literal: Youxue refuted the book and memorialized forcefully enumerating its errors.
translations.idiomatic: Youxue rebutted the book and submitted a forceful memorial detailing its faults.

sentences.zh: 疏雖留中，鏤板盡毀。

translations.literal: Although the memorial was kept at court, all printing blocks were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was kept at court, but every printing block was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 以員外郎恤刑畿輔，出矜疑三百餘人。

translations.literal: As vice director he conducted compassionate review of capital cases in the capital region and released more than three hundred persons whose guilt was doubtful.
translations.idiomatic: Serving as vice director on a compassionate review of capital cases in the capital region, he released more than three hundred prisoners whose guilt was uncertain.

sentences.zh: 進郎中。

translations.literal: Promoted to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 遷湖州知府，甫至，即捕殺豪惡奴。

translations.literal: Transferred to prefect of Huzhou; as soon as he arrived he arrested and executed tyrannical slaves of powerful families.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed prefect of Huzhou, he had barely arrived when he arrested and executed the brutal henchmen of local magnates.

sentences.zh: 有施敏者，士族子，楊升者，人奴也，橫郡中。

translations.literal: There was Shi Min, son of a gentry family, and Yang Sheng, a man's slave; both tyrannized the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: One was Shi Min, a scion of the gentry; the other was Yang Sheng, a household slave. Both ran roughshod over the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 幼學執敏置諸獄。

translations.literal: Youxue seized Min and imprisoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Youxue arrested Min and threw him in prison.

sentences.zh: 敏賂貴人囑巡撫檄取親鞫，幼學執不予，立杖殺之。

translations.literal: Min bribed a powerful man to ask the grand coordinator to dispatch an order summoning him for personal trial; Youxue firmly refused and immediately had him beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Min bribed a court favorite to have the grand coordinator issue an order summoning him for a personal hearing. Youxue refused to release him and had him beaten to death on the spot.

sentences.zh: 敏獄辭連故尚書潘季馴子廷圭，幼學言之御史，疏劾之，下獄。

translations.literal: Min's confession implicated Tinggui, son of the former minister Pan Jixun; Youxue reported this to the censor and memorialized impeachment; Tinggui was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Min's testimony implicated Tinggui, son of the former minister Pan Jixun. Youxue reported the matter to the censor, memorialized for impeachment, and Tinggui was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 他奸豪復論殺數十輩，獨楊升畏禍斂跡，置之。

translations.literal: Other powerful ruffians were likewise sentenced to death in dozens; only Yang Sheng, fearing disaster, restrained himself, and Youxue let him be.
translations.idiomatic: Dozens of other powerful ruffians were likewise sentenced to death. Only Yang Sheng, fearing the consequences, kept his head down, and Youxue left him alone for the time being.

sentences.zh: 已，念己去，升必復逞，遂捕置之死，一郡大治。

translations.literal: Later, thinking that once he left Sheng would again run wild, he had him arrested and put to death; the whole prefecture was greatly well governed.
translations.idiomatic: Later, realizing that once he himself departed Sheng would revert to his old ways, he had him arrested and executed. The whole prefecture was then brought thoroughly to order.

sentences.zh: 霪雨連月，禾盡死。

translations.literal: Rain fell incessantly for months and the grain all died.
translations.idiomatic: Months of unrelenting rain destroyed the entire crop.

sentences.zh: 幼學大舉荒政，活饑民三十四萬有奇。

translations.literal: Youxue launched famine relief on a great scale and saved more than three hundred forty thousand starving people.
translations.idiomatic: Youxue mounted a large-scale famine relief effort and kept more than three hundred forty thousand starving people alive.

sentences.zh: 御史將薦之，征其治行，推官閻世科列上三十六事，御史以聞。

translations.literal: The censor was about to recommend him and requested his record of governance; Vice Magistrate Yan Shike listed thirty-six items and the censor reported them.
translations.idiomatic: When the censor was about to recommend him and asked for his record of governance, Vice Magistrate Yan Shike submitted a list of thirty-six achievements, which the censor reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 詔加按察副使，仍視郡事。

translations.literal: An edict added the rank of vice regional inspector while he continued to oversee prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted him to vice regional inspector while he continued to administer the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 久之，以副使督九江兵備。

translations.literal: After a long time, as vice commissioner he supervised military preparedness at Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: After some years he served as vice commissioner supervising military preparedness at Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 幼學年已七十，其母尚在，遂以終養歸。

translations.literal: Youxue was already seventy and his mother was still alive; he therefore returned home to care for her until her death.
translations.idiomatic: Youxue was already seventy, and with his mother still living he returned home to spend her remaining years at her side.

sentences.zh: 母卒，不復出。

translations.literal: When his mother died he did not go out again.
translations.idiomatic: After his mother died he never took office again.

sentences.zh: 天啟三年起南京光祿少卿，改太常少卿，俱不赴。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianqi he was recalled as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments in Nanjing and transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; he accepted neither post.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianqi he was recalled to serve as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments in Nanjing and then as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, but he declined both appointments.

sentences.zh: 明年卒，年八十四矣。

translations.literal: The next year he died, aged eighty-four.
translations.idiomatic: He died the following year at the age of eighty-four.

sentences.zh: 中矣、湖州並祠祀之。

translations.literal: Both Zhongmou and Huzhou enshrined him in worship.
translations.idiomatic: He was enshrined in both Zhongmou and Huzhou.
